title: Fortnite Default Dance
blurb: No emote in gaming history has caused more genuine offence with fewer resources. Fortnite's default dance is free, it belongs to everybody, and performing it over a defeated opponent communicates something no purchased celebration can: you were beaten by somebody who did not even spend money. It escaped the game entirely, turning up in football celebrations, school corridors and courtrooms of public opinion. Play it after any victory where rubbing it in is the entire point of having won. The dance is optional; the disrespect very much is not.
origin: The music from Fortnite's Default Dance emote.
